The unit is meant to stop before the half Kaddish on pp. 96/97, but the excerpt does not show whether Psalm 24 is printed before that Kaddish (in this unit's scope) or belongs to a later unit. As it stands, the 'one bilingual sequence' claim and the stopping point are not consistent with the Hebrew index.

The differences are intended: the Hebrew-only exodus/15/19 is present, and the az_yashir module is broken into a range plus a separate 15:18. No English 15:19 or other translator was added.

Line 351: the range starts at a canonical Bible URN (bible:exodus/15/1) and ends at a module-internal siddur URN (az_yashir/quoted_exodus_15_18). I could not check this against the module XML, which was out of scope. The standing rubric is a point tei:note[@type='instruction'] placed just before vayevarekh_david. That matches the guideline's 'Rise.' example, and because it opens no range, its 'until after ברכו' wording can run past the end of this unit without any scope problem. In the documentary index it appears only in the Hebrew project, with facs n85, as instructed.
